name: Button
summary: An action. Primary for the one main action on a screen.
usage: h-control px-control rounded-control text-body font-medium bg-action-primary hover:bg-action-primary-hover text-on-action

name: Secondary button
summary: Every action that isn't the main one.
usage: h-control px-control rounded-control text-body font-medium bg-action-secondary hover:bg-action-secondary-hover text-primary border border-strong

name: Danger button
summary: Revoke, delete, disable. Never for a main action that can be undone.
usage: h-control px-control rounded-control text-body font-medium bg-action-danger hover:bg-action-danger-hover text-on-action

name: Text field
summary: Single-line input with a visible label.
usage: h-control px-control rounded-control text-body bg-surface-raised text-primary border border-strong

name: Table
summary: Rows take row height from density. Header cells are captions.
usage: tbody tr: h-row border-b border-default; th: text-caption font-medium text-muted px-medium; td: text-body px-medium

name: Card
summary: A titled group on the page. Use section with a heading.
usage: p-card rounded-card bg-surface-raised border border-default shadow-raised flex flex-col gap-medium

name: Dialog
summary: A decision that stops the page.

name: Status label
summary: State of a record. Always has text, colour is never the only signal.
usage: text-caption font-medium text-ok | text-warn | text-critical rounded-control px-small py-tight
